The '''spraystick''' was a handheld weapon that saw use during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The weapon was capable of lethally spraying a chemical at the target. The spraystick was given the designation of a [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] though it resembled a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]], both in size and in shape.

==Behind the scenes==
The spraystick appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. The spraystick was designated as a rifle in the game, despite being a small handheld weapon.
